newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy data now accessible on Internet.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy data now accessible on Internet.

text.p: KN Energy Inc said Thursday it has become the first natural gas transmission company to provide its customers with an electronic bulletin board accessible through the World Wide Web, or Internet.
KN Energy developed a new system, called KN's Energy Market, to improve its service to shippers and operators that transport natural gas on KN's pipelines, it said.

KN Energy has replaced its old bulletin board system -- called KNnect -- with a system that provides KN Energy customers with an Internet-based information and transaction system for its natural gas pipeline that is available through KN Energy's home page on the Internet at www.kne.com.

KN'S Energy Market "is the first transactional application available to the natural gas industry over the Internet," the company claimed. It uses NeXT Computer Inc's WebObjects application. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
